Anna W: Quick check — Tenant X cutover status? Network handoff today at 17:00 PST, need final OK on egress + certs.
Raj P: egress rules mostly done, waiting on customer NAT IP list. Pinged acct team.
Maya L: I have the cert rotation PR open: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/482 — needs Ben review.
Ben C: on it, will review in next 30m. FYI canary nodes still using old cert until rotation merged.
Anna W: Who's owning the airgap artifact signing? we need checks before image push.
Raj P: Tom S owns signing but he's OOO this afternoon. Maya can you hand off to Ben if needed?
Maya L: I can, but need the sig key from Vault. @InfraBot can you confirm key access path?
InfraBot: [deploy-bot] Vault path for tenant-x signing key: secret/tenant-x/signing. Access requires approver group infra-deploy.
Ben C: I have approver perms. If Tom is OOO, I'll perform signing after PR is green.
Anna W: Great. Also need explicit owner for egress fallback policy (if NAT not provided). @Raj P please confirm.
Raj P: I'll own fallback policy. Plan: 1) add static NAT 2) fail-open to proxy for 2 hours 3) notify customer. Draft in runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/tenant-x-cutover
Maya L: Can ops run a quick smoke deploying edge image to staging? I can trigger once PR merged.
Ben C: I'll merge the PR after review and kick staging canary. ETA 45-60m.
Anna W: Ok — action items: Ben review+merge, Ben sign if Tom OOO, Raj implement fallback, Ops smoke once canary up. Ping here when each done :thumbsup:
Tom S: (back online) I'm reachable for signing if needed, thanks for the handoff.
Anna W: Awesome — if anything slips, we'll delay cutover by 4 hours. Thanks all.
